Stage-2 (above 50- and 200-DMA, trend_up_50_over_200), 3m RS +16.8%, ATR 3.78%. Networking's 1-month momentum is -15.3%; ANET is the relative winner inside a weak group, not a clone of the book's DELL+HPE losses. Sized at ~70% of the 1% risk budget ($105 on $984.79 equity; stop 6.3% / ~1.7x ATR under today's $192.98 low) so a fade toward $198-$200 can be added rather than chased through the ~$206 20-day high.

proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 28 analysts at Strong Buy (mean 1.26) with a $241.04 target, +17.8% vs the $204.63 live print, while the networking group prints -15.3% 1-month momentum and the stock is still 8.1% off the $214.89 52-week high on yesterday's close. MY VIEW: the market is pricing ANET as just another AI-supplier beta that should trade with DELL/HPE; the $192.98-$204.91 range on 2026-09-17 is the $195 throwback completing, not a failed bounce. MECHANISM: consensus lumps Ethernet switching into hyperscaler_server_capex; Arista's actual layer is scale-up/scale-across fabric (Etherlink) where the FY2026 $12.6B / ~40% growth guide is a share-shift into its sockets, not GPU pass-through — that is why a -15% networking tape can coexist with a 28-analyst $241 mean. RESOLUTION: a daily close that holds $198 (the 2026-09-16 close / anchored VWAP $195.51 zone) through 2026-09-24, and the ~2026-11-03 print confirming the $12.6B path.
